title.narrative: ''Venture Capital Instrument of the Trade and Competitiveness Programme - Egypt and Jordan

description.narrative: In the context of enhancing the trade relations with Egypt and Jordan, the general objective of this Action is to improve access to equity finance and value-additive support for innovative SMEs in need of early stage capital. The specific objectives of this Action will be to: support an early-stage venture capital fund primarily focused on Egypt in order to address the critical lack of equity capital and value additive operational support for high growth and innovative Egyptian SMEs.
